name: retrace
description: Record orchflows assignments and verdicts in a Retrace ledger, bound to the inspected head.

interface.shortDescription: Independent review with the assignment and verdict recorded in Retrace.
interface.longDescription: Wraps orchflows' orch-review: records the routing decision before the reviewer launches and the reviewer's verdict after, both bound to the inspected commit, in a Retrace provenance ledger.
interface.defaultPrompt: $retrace:retrace-review — review this candidate and record the routing assignment and the verdict.
